notes.title: Patch notes for v1.15 of the game
notes.content:
Patch notes for v1.15 of the game

[u]Features[/u]
[list]
[*] Revamped 206 of the art collectibles in the game!  Collectibles have changed thematically from images taken on the protagonist's phone, to sketches in the protagonist's sketch book.  This means the collectibles will likewise looks more like sketches that the protagonist has created throughout the school year.  The collection mechanism has not changed, and players will retain the same sketches they collected before the patch.  Only the artwork has changed.
[*] Related to the above artwork change, kidnappers will now send Polaroid pictures of their victims through the game with their own art style.
[/list]


[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed misspellings in select art collectibles entries
[*] Cleaned up several AI artifacts in the art collectibles
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.14 of the game
notes.content:
[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed Walter's dates that were erroneously going on Ryan's dates instead.
[*]Fixed afternoon event where players attempted to spend time with Ryan, only to have the game unable to advance.
[*]Fixed collectible image of Kelly in bed to more align with game's description of the scene.
[*]Fixed grammatical error in interaction with Professor Valerie.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.13 of the game
notes.content:
Features
[list]
[*]The launch version of Tickle Magnet included 2 dates with Natalie.  This has been increased to 4 dates total due to popular demand!  The fourth date is repeatable, similar to how 8th dates are repeatable with the inner circle characters.  If players have already gone on a second date with Natalie, they will need to start a new character to enjoy the third and fourth dates.
[*]Ryan is now a character the player can go on two dates with.  Through a series of flashbacks, one of the dates gives more a glimpse into what life was like for the captives that spent time with the villains of the game.
[*]For the fourth date with Natalie, a new feature has been added: a climax gauge and a broken gauge.  Depending on your interactions with Natalie during the fourth date, she can experience sexual climax or you can break her through tickle torture if you make certain selections during the date.  Tutorials are included in the game that explain the system.
[/list]


Bugs
[list]
[*]Fixed side quest "Ice Ice Cravings" notes to only need one of each treat, not 4.  The previous note was misleading to what the player had to do to complete the quest.
[*]Moved manager in Food n Stuff.  Trying to get a job was causing the explanations of the gift cards to not remove itself.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.12 of the game
notes.content:
[u]Features[/u]
[list]
[*]Added new content to the work study program.  Curious characters may get visited by Professor Robinson while performing their work study program duties.  Those interested in running the study get to interview two fellow students: one female, one male and perhaps put them into ticklish situations.
[*]Added a raspberry tickling scene in an Autumn date.
[/list]

[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a misspelling in the Thanksgiving event if the player chooses Autumn.
[*]Changed in game sprites for Professor Robinson to better match her artwork.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.11 of the game
notes.content:
[u]Features[/u]
[list]
[*]During the evenings in their bedroom, players with enough Curiosity can now access their laptop to turn on or off new relationship meters.  The meters will show, on a scale of 1-100, how much relationship points you have with your five inner circle friends.
[*]Added a new tier of armor, footwear, and offhand items that can be purchased around town after the first Tickling Combat dungeon is cleared.
[*]Added gift certificates to select stores on the Ave.  The gift certificates act as gifts that you can give to friends when you spend time texting them.  If you have the right gift certificate for the person you're trying to impress, the game will ask if you wish to give them the gift certificate in exchange for extra relationship.  Added a gift certificate tutorial to the game.
[*]A new quest NPC has appeared!  A comic book collector is seeking pages to the tickling fetish comic book Tickle Magnet #1.  Players who complete this quest will have access to the entire Tickle Magnet #1 comic book in the Image Gallery.
[/list]

[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*]After the first day of school, fixed a bug where the wrong version of Fiona was getting called, sometimes causing the game to crash.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.1 of the game
notes.content:
Features
[list]
[*]Tickle Magnet now has a fully functional tutorial system! This was a popular players request.  The tutorials cover player's stats in the game, different locations in Ravensworth, and much more clarity on the optional Tickling Combat system.  The tutorials may also be turned off in the options menu.  They can be accessed at any time through the main menu.  While the tutorial system presumes a new game being launched, all tutorials will be opened up at the end of each calendar month (in game) for those players with saved games already going.
[*]Main Quest "A Voice like Velvet" had a description change to more clearly identify what one could bribe Marlina with.
[*]To alleviate confusion why the Four C's weren't raising after each after school activity, the main character now says a quick note when the stats don't raise.
[*]Added "RU" to the front of the University sign.
[*]Added more clarity, in the form of pop-up windows in game, that players can find the soccer field and pool by following the trails to the left and right of the school, respectively.
[*]Player reported bug that damage over time abilities (Special attacks) weren't killing Tickling Combat adversaries.  Added note in the tutorials that even if a damage over time ability takes an enemy to 0 willpower, you still need to hit them once to defeat them.
[/list]

Bugs
[list]
[*]Reduced the chances Instill Doubt will proc its paralyzing ability from 100%->40%.
[*]An NPC in the library (Francis) had incorrect facial graphics when starting a dialogue.
[*]An NPC in the library (Francis) wasn't giving the usual quest flag wave when giving the player his tutoring job quest.
[*]Fixed bug where players could walk diagonally through the walls in some places in the Loose Screws store.
[*]Fixed misspelling of the word "grave" on the September 13th event.
[*]Fixed misspelling of the word "congratulate" on an Autumn date.
[*]Main character comments that it's a beautiful, sunny day when first meeting Mrs. Duthie on the Ave, yet the weather is pouring rain.
[/list]

Game adjustments
[list]
[*]Slightly reduced the benefit of strong Stamina on the loss of Studies each night.
[/list]

notes.title: Game launch March 15, 2024
notes.content:
Patch notes for the launch version of the game v1.0

[u]Features[/u]
[list]
[*]Autumn has several new voice acting lines added throughout the game.
[/list]

[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*]Players could still text friends after a major event took place in Chapter 10, which could cause a number of bugs if the player hung out with friends and gained favor with them.
[*]The game was using a real time element, which was causing a multiple of "The game doesn't recognize your time" errors.  I believe this mainly happened when players spent real time in one day exploring the day and it forced the game into a time it didn't recognize.  Turning off the real time element of the time system should prevent the bug.
[*]If Fiona is the player's significant other, she wasn't showing up in the final sequence in the game.  Players were getting a black screen instead.
[/list]

notes.title: Tickle Magnet Game Update
notes.content:
[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*]Patched several places in the world where the player could diagonally walk through the walls and into the textured background.
[*]Clarified the second date with Autumn on who is talking during the teacher sequence, as it was confusing to players.
[*]Fixed a bug where after taking a quest from NPCs, the NPCs would freeze, and block players into a confined space, forcing them to reboot the game.
[*]Reggie had the incorrect tickle fight prompt when you challenge him.
[/list]


[u]Features[/u]
[list]
[*]Huge new feature where you can now collect close to 200 brand new images throughout the game!  Through playing the game, performing goals, and making certain choices, players can unlock special images that go straight to your cell phone.  The images are markers of events that you experience throughout your play through of Tickle Magnet.  These gallery images are available to see through the title screen, or on the main menu during playing.
[*]Removed the calendar function from the main menu as it wasn't supported and just cluttering up the UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Tickle Magnet Game Update
notes.content:
[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*]Parent's portraits didn't always vanish after the end of school year event
[*]the quest giver in the Sassy Ex was moving before giving her quest, then stop moving afterwards, which would sometimes trap players in the shop.  Changed behavior so she never moves.
[*] Fixed reward description in the "Loyalty Pledge" quest.
[*] Encounters with the police would often end in player deaths.  Re calibrated the event so likelihood of "Game Over" is reduced.
[*] Stamina didn't have much impact on the game.  Instead of losing 2 Study every night, players either lose no Study stat if their Stamina is high enough, or will lose more if their Stamina gets too low.  Added a reminder every night reminding the player how their health is doing.
[*] Second date with Miss Dawes mistakenly said the player wakes up the next day, when in reality the game just forwards to the evening time slot as intended.
[*] Derrick had Autumn's biography listed in his status screen.
[*] The Main Character had nothing listed in their status screen.
[/list]


[u]Features[/u]
[list]
[*] The male students and male townspeople have received graphical upgrades.
[*] There is a brand new, interrogation side quest that pops up in three different places after the player completes the quest "Loyalty Pledge."  The participants are kept quiet to avoid spoilers.
[*] Players can scroll up and down the right side of the quest log by using the left and right bumper buttons on their controller.
[*] Added a daily check to wipe out graphical busts that should have been removed, but weren't.
[*] Added a heal over time buff under "Support" to any of the five inner circle friends after you complete the third date with them.
[*] Added a tanking mechanism where inner circle friends gain a provoke ability after you complete the sixth date with them.
[*] Fixed accessories so you can now equip them for tickle fights.
[*] Added a place to buy accessories in both the Food N Stuff store and The Loose Screws hardware store.  The inventory of available accessories grows as the player completes dungeons.
[/list]

notes.title: Tickle Magnet Game Update
notes.content:
The alpha build of the game has been uploaded with the following changes:

[u]Bugs[/u]
[list]
[*] Esa's character model wasn't appearing when talking with her.
[*] Players couldn't buy rope at the Hardware store.
[/list]

[u]Features[/u]
[list]
[*] Ticklish laughter has been improved throughout the entire game to make the game feel more dynamic.  There will be more screen shakes to simulate the "jumpiness of the character being initially tickled" plus the laughter text pops out at the player more.  The same with sexual dialogue, it likewise has been improved to clearly demonstrate when a character is aroused.
[*] We have added more facial expressions for the five inner circle characters to give them more personality throughout the story.
[*] We have combed the story's script and added more facial feature changes in characters to give the scenes more depth and life.
[*] Added more dialogue options through the game for the player to exercise the four C's (Craft, Charisma, Curiosity, and Cleverness).  When players meet the pre-requiste for the skill check, a new dialogue option will appear, which is generally more beneficial than the other options.
[/list]
